<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3ba52069197858607f27ffd8a63b8921e06fd6cc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cbd231941209c68ff5881ba988b77222e7b5976c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts and sys-two-factor.object.ts (the `enable_two_factor` action of each loses its `ai` block), sys-invitation.object.ts (`copy_invitation_link` keeps none, now with the bucket comment), docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md (the 2026-10-31 amendment note, the H/C/E name lists, the counts, the "not assessed" paragraph, the MCP paragraphs), .changeset/28368-identity-two-factor-invite-link-human-only.md (new, platform-objects patch) and the DELIBERATE CORRECTION of .changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md (the pending #27900 changeset's counts and name lists)

Inputs: card #28368 (the three items of ruling `6540309323` on #27900, the maintainer's 「其他同意」 of 2026-10-31T06:53Z: `copy_invitation_link` assessed H, both `enable_two_factor` moved E to H, `sys_approval_request`'s 9 actions noted unassessed and human-only), PR #28386 (body with the three items, the amended counts and the two changesets, the `Metadata-protocol` amendment `6541378586` to `none`, the seat's hand-off `6541730064`; 6 files, +40/−28, the diff read whole), the 54 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T11:50Z: 54 runs on this head, 35 success, 17 skipped, 2 failure; the 2 failures are both runs of `Check Changeset`, the designed `check-empty-changeset` DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal of `.changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md`, red until a person confirms the correction at landing; every other latest run per name is green: Build Core, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Lint UI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Test UI (matrix shard/16), Type Check UI, UI Published Artifacts), the job log of the red `Check Changeset` run (124502062205: `check-empty-changeset` refuses `.changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md` because it exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR; `check-adr-0087-registration` and the no-major check in the same job passed), and the tree at this head for the counts: the three ADR name lists hold 23, 17 and 19 unique names (59), and `ai: {` occurs 36 times across the identity objects (sys-user 7, sys-two-factor 0, sys-invitation 5, the rest unchanged). No file of this PR moved on `main` since the merge-base; the head is mergeable.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The ruling is applied exactly, nothing more** - right. Item 2: the two `enable_two_factor` declarations drop `ai: { exposed: true, description }` and carry the bucket-H comment, so `systemObjectActionExposureError` (ADR-0066 D4) no longer lists them over MCP and `run_action` refuses them by name; the Console runs them as before, since the `ai` block never gated a signed-in person. Item 1: `copy_invitation_link` was already undeclared; the PR adds the comment only, which is what bucket H means in the ADR table (no `ai` block). The card's item 1 wording 「gets an ai block, tier H」 reads as shorthand for "assessed into bucket H"; the ruling text and the ADR's H row both say no block, and the diff follows them. Item 3: the "Not assessed" paragraph now names `sys_approval_request`'s 9 actions, with the prior `copy_invitation_link` sentence retired since it is assessed. No action gains exposure, so no new MCP surface opens.
- **The ADR addendum is the amended record and its arithmetic holds** - right. The amendment note cites the ruling by id and date, the H list adds the three names (20 → 23), the E list loses the two (21 → 19), C is untouched (17), and 23 + 17 + 19 = 59 = the 58 of the 2026-10-30 assessment plus `copy_invitation_link`. Declared blocks 36 = C 17 + E 19, which matches the tree's 36 `ai: {` occurrences; the MCP paragraphs' 38 → 36 and 37 → 35 (36 less the one REST-route forward, `revoke_api_key`) follow. The paragraph keeping the 2026-10-30 figures (58 / 38, the card's H 19 / E 22 headers) is kept as history, not as the current count.
- **The DELIBERATE CORRECTION of the #27900 changeset is accurate sentence by sentence** - right. #27900's changeset is pending (unreleased), so its text is what the release notes will say; the correction changes the header counts (58/38 → 59/36), drops "enabling two-factor authentication" from the Exposed (19) sentence, adds "enabling two-factor authentication" and "copying an invitation's accept link" to the Human-only (23) sentence, and removes the sentence that said `copy_invitation_link` "was not part of the assessment", which would now be false. Every other sentence is byte-identical. The new changeset carries the same three facts as a `fix` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` at `patch`.
- **Clause-② `no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`** - accepted. The `ai` block is a platform-object declaration, not a spec key; the schema of `ActionSchema.ai` is untouched; what changes is which shipped actions declare it. The symmetric #27900 (#28270) declared `no` for the additions, so the removals declare `no` too; the amendment `6541378586` from `narrowed` to `none` is the right reading (nothing an author writes changes). The behaviour change for an MCP agent (two actions no longer listed) is the declared fix and is why this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above. Every latest run per name on this head is green or skipped except `Check Changeset`, which is red on both of its runs for one reason: `check-empty-changeset` refuses a PR that edits a changeset it did not add. That refusal is the gate's designed DELIBERATE CORRECTION door (a correction of another PR's pending changeset stays red until a person confirms it at landing); the correction here is the whole point of the PR and is judged accurate above. The rest of that job passed. This record does not clear that door; the human approver does.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/platform-objects` patch** - accepted. Two actions lose a declaration and nothing else moves; the `fix` title names the behaviour change for an agent. The corrected #27900 changeset keeps its own `patch`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Tier H, human approval owed** - `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` is a GOVERNED surface, so this PR lands only with a GOVERNED_APPROVER's approval (os-zhuang or hotlong); no reviewer is requested on the PR yet, and Tesla's routing asks for os-zhuang to be requested when he is the approver. That approval is also where the DELIBERATE CORRECTION of `.changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md` is confirmed, so the red `Check Changeset` leg is expected to stay red until then; it is not a defect of this head.
- **Ordering against #27900** - this PR edits the changeset #27900 (#28270, merged) added, so it lands after it, which the merge-base already satisfies. If #27900's changeset were consumed by a release before this lands, the correction would need to move into this PR's own changeset instead; nothing suggests that today.
- **`sys_approval_request`** - the 9 actions are now recorded unassessed and human-only; a later assessment is a ruling, not a code change, and no card exists for it.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: whether dropping `ai` on `sys_user.enable_two_factor` leaves `sys_user.disable_two_factor` consistent (it was H already, so the pair is now H/H, which reads right: both sides of a sign-in factor are human-only); whether any test pinned the 38 or 21 counts (none in the tree; the ADR says no automatic check by the maintainer's choice); whether the two identical `enable_two_factor` descriptions were referenced elsewhere (no). Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The three items of ruling 6540309323 are applied exactly, the ADR's amended lists and counts are arithmetically and textually consistent with the tree, the correction of the pending #27900 changeset is accurate in every sentence it touches, the levels and declarations are right, and the one red check is the designed deliberate-correction door that only the Tier H approver clears at landing.

**VERDICT: PASS**

ACCEPT · PR #28386 · Head-sha `cbd231941209c68ff5881ba988b77222e7b5976c` · 2026-10-31T11:52Z · Tier H, approval owed

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 两个 `enable_two_factor` 动作（`sys_user` 与 `sys_two_factor`）删掉 `ai` 块，从 E 档移到 H 档；`sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` 评为 H 档，保持不写 `ai` 块。ADR-0011 附记更新三档名单（H23 / C17 / E19，共 36 个 `ai` 块、59 个动作），并加一行：`sys_approval_request` 的 9 个动作未评估，评估前一律仅限人工。同时更正尚未发布的 #27900 changeset 里的计数与名单。
- **为什么改：** 执行您在 #27900 上的裁决「其他同意」。启用双因素要用户密码、返回新的登录因子；邀请链接本身就是凭据。两者都不该让 agent 拿到。
- **风险与回滚：** 只收窄 agent 能看到的动作，Console 里登录用户的操作不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 的修订注记与名单；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` 的 `enable_two_factor`。
- **两分钟验证：** `grep -c "ai: {" packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts` 合计应为 36，且 `enable_two_factor` 下不再有 `ai:`。
- **需要你做的：** 批准本 PR（触及 ADR，Tier H）。达档合约审查 PASS：comment 6542995471，Head-sha `cbd231941209c68ff5881ba988b77222e7b5976c`。批准后席位落地。

席位意见：三条裁决逐字落实，ADR 计数与代码树一致，#27900 changeset 的更正逐句核过；唯一的红是有意设计的"更正他人待发 changeset"门，可带红入队。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 6 files, +40/−28. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28386`: 1 of 6 paths governed (`docs/adr/**`), so Tier H: maintainer approval from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` before landing. `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none` (amendment 6541378586); the contract review accepts both.
- **Premise measured:** ruling 6540309323 on #27900 (the maintainer's 「其他同意」). Contract review 6542995471 (Served-tier `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, same head, **VERDICT: PASS**) checks the three items against the tree: 36 `ai: {` blocks, lists of 23/17/19 = 59.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 54 runs: 35 success, 17 skipped, 2 failure. Both failures are `Check Changeset`, the designed `check-empty-changeset` DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal of `.changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md`. Its confirmation is on record: the same-head at-tier PASS (6542995471, ① third bullet) judges each rewritten sentence of that note. Three conditions for entering the queue red, all met: the script states the red is by design (`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` "Past a designed red"); `pr-automation.yml` (which runs Check Changeset) has no `merge_group` trigger; this comment records the gate and its cause.
- **Accepted deviations:** card item 1's wording 「gets an ai block, tier H」 is read as "assessed into bucket H", which per the ruling and the ADR's H row means no block. The diff follows the ruling.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** the assessment of `sys_approval_request`'s 9 actions is a later ruling with no card yet. `Skills-docs: none`.
- **Landing clause:** Tier H endgame. `needs-user-decision` goes on this PR and the approver review is requested now. Once an authorized approver approves, the seat removes the label, flips ready, enables auto-merge, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28368.
